title: Condensed coefficient rings of continuous functions
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with its absolute value extending the $\ell$-adic absolute value, and a finite subextension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside it. Give $E$ the induced topology as in [def-sfb-padic-subfield-condensed-ring]. Write $\mathcal O_E=\{x\in E:|x|\leq1\}$ for its valuation subring with the subspace topology as in [def-sfb-padic-integers-condensed-ring], and let $\varpi$ be a uniformizer as in [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension].

For $T\in\{\mathcal O_E,E\}$, with the topology induced from $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, let $\underline T$ be the presheaf of commutative rings on the point site $*_{\Proet}$ of [pur713-def-point-site] with

$$
\underline T(S)=C(S,T),\qquad S\in *_{\Proet},
$$

the ring of continuous maps $S\to T$ with pointwise operations, restriction being composition. No completeness or limit presentation of $T$ enters this definition: $\underline E$ is not defined as $\underline{\mathcal O}_E[1/\varpi]$, nor $\underline{\mathcal O}_E$ as $\lim_n\underline{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}$.
